source.commit_subject: fix(ecc2): make purpleguard harness runner host-portable

llm_provider_layer.decision: retain PurpleGuard's own provider layer (agent_api/llm_provider.py, llm_client.py)
llm_provider_layer.ecc_src_llm: DEFERRED — not extracted; adopting it later must go through ecc/bridge as a single provider layer
llm_provider_layer.rationale: PurpleGuard already owns a working provider layer; do not replace working infrastructure.

integration_style.rationale: ECC capabilities are reached via ecc/bridge; PurpleGuard security engine stays authoritative; ecc2 is built and bridged, not translated.

components.reason: ECC 2.0 control plane: session store/lifecycle, 4-axis risk scoring, worktree management, inter-agent comms, TUI.
components.integration_method: BUILD the crate; invoke/reach through ecc/bridge (Decision B). Not built by PurpleGuard's Python package.
components.tests: ecc2 unit tests are inside the crate (session/observability/config/manager/etc.)
components.notes: tui/ is included because the crate compiles as a unit; TUI is reference-only. Self-described alpha.

components.reason: The [harness_runners.purpleguard] config that dispatches ECC tasks to purpleguard_runner.py, and the ECC agent/skill manifest.
dependencies: python3 at runtime when the harness fires
components.integration_method: Consumed by ecc2; documents the ECC->PurpleGuard invocation contract.

components.reason: Reusable template for an opt-in, fail-closed external trust gate with a threat model.
components.integration_method: Optional; call through ecc/bridge if a trust gate is added. Read-only network GET; no secrets.

components.reason: Role definitions for the PurpleGuard Security Agent Workforce (see docs/ECC_AGENT_WORKFORCE.md).
components.integration_method: Foundation of the agent workforce; available adapters are exposed via ecc/bridge/workforce/.

components.reason: Reusable skill specs for security review/scan, verification, eval, continuous/autonomous loops, orchestration, TDD, budgets, python patterns.
dependencies: some skills ship helper scripts (python) as assets; not imported by PurpleGuard
components.integration_method: Reference; not wired. Reach any executable skill logic via ecc/bridge.

components.reason: Orchestration/planning/security/session command definitions (orch-*, multi-*, plan*, prp-*, epic-*, sessions, quality-gate, security-scan, ...).
components.integration_method: Reference for orchestration workflows; no PurpleGuard wiring yet.

components.reason: Coding/security/style rules relevant to PurpleGuard's Python + web stack.
components.integration_method: Reference; non-Python/web language rule packs intentionally omitted.

components.reason: Reusable JSON contracts (state store, provenance, hooks, install) to inform task/result/event contracts.
components.integration_method: Reference for Phases 16-18 contract design (adapt, do not copy verbatim).

components.reason: Architecture, session-adapter contract, observability, skill/command governance docs.
ECC's own ecc2 analysis (architecture, gaps, dependency health).
components.integration_method: Reference; NOTE: partially stale (reports ecc2 smaller than it is now).

components.reason: Preserve ECC's MIT license and attribution.

General-purpose interaction: PurpleGuard has the Next.js frontend; TUI kept only because the crate compiles as a unit.
